store.description: A fictional catalogue of handloom, vintage and everyday clothing for exploring InstaBazaar. All listings and illustrations are sample content.

products.title: Olive Chanderi Silk Kurta
products.description: Olive green Chanderi silk kurta with hand block print detailing, relaxed fit and round neckline. Lightweight festive wear in S, M, L and XL. Hand wash separately in cold water. Fictional sample product.
products.reelCaption: Olive green hand block print Chanderi silk kurta for festive gatherings. Relaxed fit in sizes S to XL. #handloom #chanderi

products.title: Indigo Denim Workwear Jacket
products.description: Indigo denim jacket with contrast stitching, button fastening and two patch pockets. Relaxed unisex fit for casual layering. Sizes M, L and XL. Cold wash inside out. Fictional sample product.
products.reelCaption: Indigo denim workwear jacket with contrast stitching and a relaxed unisex fit. #denim #workwear

products.title: Terracotta Linen Midi Dress
products.description: Terracotta linen midi dress with a gathered waist and side pockets. Breathable everyday silhouette in S, M and L. Wash gently and dry in shade. Fictional sample product.
products.reelCaption: Terracotta linen midi dress with practical side pockets for everyday styling. #linen #mididress

products.title: Ivory Cotton Embroidered Top
products.description: Ivory cotton top with tonal floral embroidery, three-quarter sleeves and a relaxed fit. A casual wardrobe staple in XS, S, M and L. Gentle hand wash recommended. Fictional sample product.
products.reelCaption: Ivory cotton embroidered top with relaxed sleeves. #cotton #embroidery #casual

products.title: Rose Handwoven Silk Saree
products.description: Rose silk saree with a subtle woven border and matching unstitched blouse piece. One size, approximately 6.3 metres including blouse fabric. Festive and wedding styling. Dry clean only. Fictional sample product.
products.reelCaption: Rose handwoven silk saree with a subtle woven border for festive occasions. #silk #saree #handwoven

products.title: Olive Corduroy Straight Trousers
products.description: Olive corduroy trousers with a straight leg, mid-rise waist and deep pockets. Comfortable everyday workwear. Waist sizes 28, 30, 32 and 34. Machine wash on a gentle cycle. Fictional sample product.
products.reelCaption: Olive corduroy straight trousers for everyday workwear. #corduroy #trousers #workwear
